035/**
036 * Centralized data log that provides automatic data log file management. It automatically cleans up
037 * old files when disk space is low and renames the file based either on current date/time or (if
038 * available) competition match number. The data file will be saved to a USB flash drive in a folder
039 * named "logs" if one is attached, or to /home/systemcore/logs otherwise.
040 *
041 * <p>Log files are initially named "WPILIB_TBD_{random}.wpilog" until the DS connects. After the DS
042 * connects, the log file is renamed to "WPILIB_yyyyMMdd_HHmmss.wpilog" (where the date/time is
043 * UTC). If the FMS is connected and provides a match number, the log file is renamed to
044 * "WPILIB_yyyyMMdd_HHmmss_{event}_{match}.wpilog".
045 *
046 * <p>On startup, all existing WPILIB_TBD log files are deleted. If there is less than 200 MB of
047 * free space on the target storage, non-match WPILIB_ log files are deleted (oldest to newest)
048 * until there is 200 MB free OR there are 10 files remaining, including match logs. Competition
049 * match logs and their rotated segments are not deleted. An alert is active while less than 400 MB
050 * is available, checked every 5 seconds. An informational alert indicates when automatic directory
051 * selection falls back to SystemCore internal storage.
052 *
053 * <p>By default, all NetworkTables value changes are stored to the data log.
054 */
055public final class DataLogManager {
056  private static DataLogBackgroundWriter m_log;
057  private static boolean m_stopped;
058  private static String m_logDir;
059  private static boolean m_internalStorage;
060  private static boolean m_filenameOverride;
061  private static Thread m_thread;
062  private static final ZoneId m_utc = ZoneId.of("UTC");
063  private static final DateTimeFormatter m_timeFormatter =
064      DateTimeFormatter.ofPattern("yyyyMMdd_HHmmss").withZone(m_utc);
065  private static boolean m_ntLoggerEnabled = true;
066  private static int m_ntEntryLogger;
067  private static int m_ntConnLogger;
068  private static boolean m_consoleLoggerEnabled = true;
069  private static FileLogger m_consoleLogger;
070  private static StringLogEntry m_messageLog;
071
072  // if less than this much free space, delete log files until there is this much free space
073  // OR there are this many files remaining.
074  private static final long FREE_SPACE_THRESHOLD = 200000000L;
075  private static final int FILE_COUNT_THRESHOLD = 10;
076
077  static boolean isMatchLog(String filename) {
078    int extensionIndex = filename.lastIndexOf(".wpilog");
079    if (extensionIndex != filename.length() - 7) {
080      return false;
081    }
082
083    int matchTypeSeparator = filename.lastIndexOf('_', extensionIndex - 1);
084    if (matchTypeSeparator < 0 || matchTypeSeparator + 2 >= extensionIndex) {
085      return false;
086    }
087
088    char matchType = filename.charAt(matchTypeSeparator + 1);
089    if (matchType != 'P' && matchType != 'Q' && matchType != 'E' && matchType != 'T') {
090      return false;
091    }
092    // Rotated logs have one numeric segment suffix, e.g. Q123.2.wpilog.
093    boolean segmentFound = false;
094    for (int i = matchTypeSeparator + 2; i < extensionIndex; i++) {
095      if (filename.charAt(i) == '.'
096          && !segmentFound
097          && i > matchTypeSeparator + 2
098          && i + 1 < extensionIndex) {
099        segmentFound = true;
100        continue;
101      }
102      if (filename.charAt(i) < '0' || filename.charAt(i) > '9') {
103        return false;
104      }
105    }
106    return true;
107  }
108
109  private DataLogManager() {}
110
111  /** Start data log manager with default directory location. */
112  public static synchronized void start() {
113    start("", "", 0.25);
114  }
115
116  /**
117   * Start data log manager. The parameters have no effect if the data log manager was already
118   * started (e.g. by calling another static function).
119   *
120   * @param dir if not empty, directory to use for data log storage
121   */
122  public static synchronized void start(String dir) {
123    start(dir, "", 0.25);
124  }
125
126  /**
127   * Start data log manager. The parameters have no effect if the data log manager was already
128   * started (e.g. by calling another static function).
129   *
130   * @param dir if not empty, directory to use for data log storage
131   * @param filename filename to use; if none provided, the filename is automatically generated
132   */
133  public static synchronized void start(String dir, String filename) {
134    start(dir, filename, 0.25);
135  }
136
137  /**
138   * Start data log manager. The parameters have no effect if the data log manager was already
139   * started (e.g. by calling another static function).
140   *
141   * @param dir if not empty, directory to use for data log storage
142   * @param filename filename to use; if none provided, the filename is automatically generated
143   * @param period time between automatic flushes to disk, in seconds; this is a time/storage
144   *     tradeoff
145   */
146  public static synchronized void start(String dir, String filename, double period) {
147    if (m_log == null) {
148      m_logDir = makeLogDir(dir);
149      m_filenameOverride = !filename.isEmpty();
150
151      // Delete all previously existing WPILIB_TBD_*.wpilog files. These only exist when the robot
152      // never connects to the DS, so they are very unlikely to have useful data and just clutter
153      // the filesystem.
154      File[] files =
155          new File(m_logDir)
156              .listFiles((d, name) -> name.startsWith("WPILIB_TBD_") && name.endsWith(".wpilog"));
157      if (files != null) {
158        for (File file : files) {
159          if (!file.delete()) {
160            System.err.println("DataLogManager: could not delete " + file);
161          }
162        }
163      }
164      m_log = new DataLogBackgroundWriter(m_logDir, makeLogFilename(filename), period);
165      m_messageLog = new StringLogEntry(m_log, "messages");
166
167      // Log all NT entries and connections
168      if (m_ntLoggerEnabled) {
169        startNtLog();
170      }
171      // Log console output
172      if (m_consoleLoggerEnabled) {
173        startConsoleLog();
174      }
175    } else if (m_stopped) {
176      m_log.setFilename(makeLogFilename(filename));
177      m_log.resume();
178      m_stopped = false;
179    }
180
181    if (m_thread == null) {
182      m_thread = new Thread(DataLogManager::logMain, "DataLogDS");
183      m_thread.setDaemon(true);
184      m_thread.start();
185    }
186  }
187
188  /** Stop data log manager. */
189  public static synchronized void stop() {
190    if (m_thread != null) {
191      m_thread.interrupt();
192      // Wait for the thread to release its alerts before another start can reuse their IDs.
193      boolean interrupted = false;
194      while (m_thread.isAlive()) {
195        try {
196          m_thread.join();
197        } catch (InterruptedException ex) {
198          interrupted = true;
199        }
200      }
201      if (interrupted) {
202        Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
203      }
204      m_thread = null;
205    }
206    if (m_log != null) {
207      m_log.stop();
208      m_stopped = true;
209    }
210  }
211
212  /**
213   * Log a message to the "messages" entry. The message is also printed to standard output (followed
214   * by a newline).
215   *
216   * @param message message
217   */
218  public static synchronized void log(String message) {
219    if (m_messageLog == null) {
220      start();
221    }
222    m_messageLog.append(message);
223    System.out.println(message);
224  }
225
226  /**
227   * Get the managed data log (for custom logging). Starts the data log manager if not already
228   * started.
229   *
230   * @return data log
231   */
232  public static synchronized DataLog getLog() {
233    if (m_log == null) {
234      start();
235    }
236    return m_log;
237  }
238
239  /**
240   * Get the log directory.
241   *
242   * @return log directory, or empty string if logging not yet started
243   */
244  public static synchronized String getLogDir() {
245    if (m_logDir == null) {
246      return "";
247    }
248    return m_logDir;
249  }
250
251  /**
252   * Enable or disable logging of NetworkTables data. Note that unlike the network interface for
253   * NetworkTables, this will capture every value change. Defaults to enabled.
254   *
255   * @param enabled true to enable, false to disable
256   */
257  public static synchronized void logNetworkTables(boolean enabled) {
258    boolean wasEnabled = m_ntLoggerEnabled;
259    m_ntLoggerEnabled = enabled;
260    if (m_log == null) {
261      start();
262      return;
263    }
264    if (enabled && !wasEnabled) {
265      startNtLog();
266    } else if (!enabled && wasEnabled) {
267      stopNtLog();
268    }
269  }
270
271  /**
272   * Enable or disable logging of the console output. Defaults to enabled.
273   *
274   * @param enabled true to enable, false to disable
275   */
276  public static synchronized void logConsoleOutput(boolean enabled) {
277    boolean wasEnabled = m_consoleLoggerEnabled;
278    m_consoleLoggerEnabled = enabled;
279    if (m_log == null) {
280      start();
281      return;
282    }
283    if (enabled && !wasEnabled) {
284      startConsoleLog();
285    } else if (!enabled && wasEnabled) {
286      stopConsoleLog();
287    }
288  }
289
290  private static String makeLogDir(String dir) {
291    if (!dir.isEmpty()) {
292      return dir;
293    }
294
295    if (RobotBase.isReal()) {
296      try {
297        // prefer a mounted USB drive if one is accessible
298        Path usbDir = Paths.get("/u").toRealPath();
299        if (Files.isWritable(usbDir)) {
300          if (!new File("/u/logs").mkdir()) {
301            // ignored
302          }
303          UsageReporting.reportUsage("DataLogManager", "USB");
304          return "/u/logs";
305        }
306      } catch (IOException ex) {
307        // ignored
308      }
309      if (!new File("/home/systemcore/logs").mkdir()) {
310        // ignored
311      }
312      UsageReporting.reportUsage("DataLogManager", "Onboard");
313      m_internalStorage = true;
314      return "/home/systemcore/logs";
315    }
316    String logDir = Filesystem.getOperatingDirectory().getAbsolutePath() + "/logs";
317    if (!new File(logDir).mkdir()) {
318      // ignored
319    }
320    return logDir;
321  }
322
323  private static String makeLogFilename(String filenameOverride) {
324    if (!filenameOverride.isEmpty()) {
325      return filenameOverride;
326    }
327    Random rnd = new Random();
328    StringBuilder filename = new StringBuilder(18);
329    filename.append("WPILIB_TBD_");
330    for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
331      filename.append(String.format("%04x", rnd.nextInt(0x10000)));
332    }
333    filename.append(".wpilog");
334    return filename.toString();
335  }
336
337  private static void startNtLog() {
338    NetworkTableInstance inst = NetworkTableInstance.getDefault();
339    m_ntEntryLogger = inst.startEntryDataLog(m_log, "", "NT:");
340    m_ntConnLogger = inst.startConnectionDataLog(m_log, "NTConnection");
341  }
342
343  private static void stopNtLog() {
344    NetworkTableInstance.stopEntryDataLog(m_ntEntryLogger);
345    NetworkTableInstance.stopConnectionDataLog(m_ntConnLogger);
346  }
347
348  private static void startConsoleLog() {
349    if (RobotBase.isReal()) {
350      m_consoleLogger = new FileLogger("/home/systemcore/WPILIB_UserProgram.log", m_log, "console");
351    }
352  }
353
354  private static void stopConsoleLog() {
355    if (RobotBase.isReal()) {
356      m_consoleLogger.close();
357    }
358  }
359
360  static void updateFreeSpaceAlert(Alert alert, long freeSpace) {
361    boolean lowSpace = freeSpace < 2 * FREE_SPACE_THRESHOLD;
362    if (lowSpace) {
363      alert.setText(
364          "DataLogManager: Log storage device has "
365              + freeSpace / 1000000
366              + " MB of free space remaining! Old logs are deleted at startup below "
367              + FREE_SPACE_THRESHOLD / 1000000
368              + " MB of free space. Consider deleting logs off the storage device.");
369    }
370    alert.set(lowSpace);
371  }
372
373  private static void checkFreeSpace(Alert alert) {
374    try {
375      updateFreeSpaceAlert(alert, Files.getFileStore(Path.of(m_logDir)).getUsableSpace());
376    } catch (IOException ex) {
377      // Keep the last known state if disk space cannot be read.
378    }
379  }
380
381  static void deleteOldLogs(File logDir, long freeSpace) {
382    if (freeSpace >= FREE_SPACE_THRESHOLD) {
383      return;
384    }
385    // Count all permanent logs toward the minimum, but only delete non-match logs.
386    File[] files =
387        logDir.listFiles(
388            (dir, name) ->
389                name.startsWith("WPILIB_")
390                    && name.endsWith(".wpilog")
391                    && !name.startsWith("WPILIB_TBD_"));
392    if (files != null) {
393      Arrays.sort(files, Comparator.comparingLong(File::lastModified));
394      int count = files.length;
395      for (File file : files) {
396        if (count <= FILE_COUNT_THRESHOLD) {
397          break;
398        }
399        if (isMatchLog(file.getName())) {
400          continue;
401        }
402        long length = file.length();
403        if (file.delete()) {
404          --count;
405          DriverStationErrors.reportWarning("DataLogManager: Deleted " + file.getName(), false);
406          freeSpace += length;
407          if (freeSpace >= FREE_SPACE_THRESHOLD) {
408            break;
409          }
410        } else {
411          System.err.println("DataLogManager: could not delete " + file);
412        }
413      }
414    }
415  }
416
417  private static void logMain() {
418    try (var internalStorageAlert =
419            new Alert(
420                "DataLogManager",
421                "internalStorage",
422                "DataLogManager: Logging to SystemCore internal storage. Attach a USB "
423                    + "drive to store logs externally.",
424                Alert.Level.LOW);
425        var freeSpaceAlert = new Alert("DataLogManager", "lowSpace", "", Alert.Level.MEDIUM)) {
426      internalStorageAlert.set(m_internalStorage);
427      logMain(freeSpaceAlert);
428    }
429  }
430
431  private static void logMain(Alert freeSpaceAlert) {
432    File logDir = new File(m_logDir);
433    deleteOldLogs(logDir, logDir.getUsableSpace());
434    checkFreeSpace(freeSpaceAlert);
435    long nextSpaceCheck = System.nanoTime() + 5_000_000_000L;
436
437    int timeoutCount = 0;
438    boolean paused = false;
439    int dsAttachCount = 0;
440    int fmsAttachCount = 0;
441    boolean dsRenamed = m_filenameOverride;
442    boolean fmsRenamed = m_filenameOverride;
443    int sysTimeCount = 0;
444    IntegerLogEntry sysTimeEntry =
445        new IntegerLogEntry(
446            m_log, "systemTime", "{\"source\":\"DataLogManager\",\"format\":\"time_t_us\"}");
447
448    Event newDataEvent = new Event();
449    DriverStationBackend.provideRefreshedDataEventHandle(newDataEvent.getHandle());
450    while (!Thread.interrupted()) {
451      boolean timedOut;
452      try {
453        timedOut = WPIUtilJNI.waitForObjectTimeout(newDataEvent.getHandle(), 0.25);
454      } catch (InterruptedException e) {
455        break;
456      }
457      if (Thread.interrupted()) {
458        break;
459      }
460      long spaceCheckTime = System.nanoTime();
461      if (spaceCheckTime - nextSpaceCheck >= 0) {
462        checkFreeSpace(freeSpaceAlert);
463        nextSpaceCheck = spaceCheckTime + 5_000_000_000L;
464      }
465      if (timedOut) {
466        timeoutCount++;
467        // pause logging after being disconnected for 10 seconds
468        if (timeoutCount > 40 && !paused) {
469          timeoutCount = 0;
470          paused = true;
471          m_log.pause();
472        }
473        continue;
474      }
475      // when we connect to the DS, resume logging
476      timeoutCount = 0;
477      if (paused) {
478        paused = false;
479        m_log.resume();
480      }
481
482      if (!dsRenamed) {
483        // track DS attach
484        if (RobotState.isDSAttached()) {
485          dsAttachCount++;
486        } else {
487          dsAttachCount = 0;
488        }
489        if (dsAttachCount > 50) { // 1 second
490          if (RobotController.isSystemTimeValid()) {
491            LocalDateTime now = LocalDateTime.now(m_utc);
492            m_log.setFilename("WPILIB_" + m_timeFormatter.format(now) + ".wpilog");
493            dsRenamed = true;
494          } else {
495            dsAttachCount = 0; // wait a bit and try again
496          }
497        }
498      }
499
500      if (!fmsRenamed) {
501        // track FMS attach
502        if (RobotState.isFMSAttached()) {
503          fmsAttachCount++;
504        } else {
505          fmsAttachCount = 0;
506        }
507        if (fmsAttachCount > 250) { // 5 seconds
508          // match info comes through TCP, so we need to double-check we've
509          // actually received it
510          MatchType matchType = MatchState.getMatchType();
511          if (matchType != MatchType.NONE) {
512            // rename per match info
513            char matchTypeChar =
514                switch (matchType) {
515                  case PRACTICE -> 'P';
516                  case QUALIFICATION -> 'Q';
517                  case ELIMINATION -> 'E';
518                  default -> 'T';
519                };
520            m_log.setFilename(
521                "WPILIB_"
522                    + m_timeFormatter.format(LocalDateTime.now(m_utc))
523                    + "_"
524                    + MatchState.getEventName()
525                    + "_"
526                    + matchTypeChar
527                    + MatchState.getMatchNumber()
528                    + ".wpilog");
529            fmsRenamed = true;
530            dsRenamed = true; // don't override FMS rename
531          }
532        }
533      }
534
535      // Write system time every ~5 seconds
536      sysTimeCount++;
537      if (sysTimeCount >= 250) {
538        sysTimeCount = 0;
539        if (RobotController.isSystemTimeValid()) {
540          sysTimeEntry.append(WPIUtilJNI.getSystemTime() / 1000L, WPIUtilJNI.now());
541        }
542      }
543    }
544    newDataEvent.close();
545  }
546}
